title: CF Convention (cf:)
description: Schema for cf information in Zarr. Properties use the 'cf:' namespace prefix.

attributes.description: Zarr attributes containing convention metadata and cf: prefixed properties

conventionMetadata.description: CF convention metadata object for use in zarr_conventions array

schema_url.description: URL to the JSON Schema definition for this convention

spec_url.description: URL to the full specification document

uuid.description: UUID that permanently identifies this convention

description.const: CF semantic metadata — standard names, units, axis, calendar, and data-quality attributes — for Zarr data variables and coordinates.
description.description: Brief description of the convention's purpose and usage

cfDescriptor.description: CF semantic attributes for one variable or coordinate. Every field is optional; unknown CF attributes pass through (additionalProperties: true).

standard_name.description: A name from the CF standard name table identifying the physical quantity.

units.description: Units of measure (UDUNITS). For time coordinates, the '<unit> since <epoch>' form, e.g. 'days since 1850-01-01'.

comment.description: Miscellaneous information about the variable or its method of production.

references.description: References that describe the variable or its method of production.

source.description: Method of production of the original data.

axis.description: Axis role for a coordinate: X, Y, Z, or T.

positive.description: Direction of increasing values for a vertical (Z) coordinate.

calendar.description: Calendar for a time coordinate, e.g. 'standard', 'proleptic_gregorian', 'noleap', '360_day'.

flag_values.description: Values corresponding to flag_meanings, for flag / category variables.

flag_masks.description: Bit masks corresponding to flag_meanings, for bitfield flags.

flag_meanings.description: Space-separated list of flag names matching flag_values / flag_masks.

ancillary_variables.description: Space-separated names of ancillary variables (e.g. uncertainty or quality-flag variables).

cfAttributes.description: CF properties using cf: key prefix. A node MUST carry at least one of 'cf:variables' (the primary placement: a catalogue map, typically on the parent group) or 'cf:attributes' (a per-array mechanism: the CF metadata of this array's own variable).

cf:variables.description: Primary placement. Map from a coordinate or variable name to a CF descriptor, typically declared once on the parent group as a catalogue for its child arrays. Also valid on an array (e.g. for its non-array coordinates). Keys match a key in a 'coords:coordinates' map or a data-variable name.

cf:attributes.description: Per-array mechanism. CF metadata of THIS array's own variable, placed directly on the variable's Zarr array metadata — the NetCDF-aligned location. Use on a data-variable array, or on an explicit coordinate array (a coords 'type: array' target).

cf:version.description: Major version of the cf convention this metadata was authored against. Optional because schema_url already pins the major.
